The City's Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan covers the area from 16 Avenue (North Bluff Road) to 24 Avenue, from around Martin Drive in the west to Earl Marriott Secondary in the east. The plan has been updated to line up with King George Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit and the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan, so this is where much of South Surrey's apartment-style housing is planned. Semiahmoo Shopping Centre (1711 152 Street) and the South Surrey Urgent and Primary Care Centre are here, along with the Semiahmoo Library (1815 152 Street).
Around 24 Avenue and 160 Street, condos sit near
and Morgan Crossing. The Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre (16855 24 Avenue) and Grandview Heights Secondary (16987 25 Avenue) are close by.

White Rock is its own city, separate from Surrey. Its multi-unit zones (RT and RM) are set by White Rock Zoning Bylaw 2506, which sets a 742 m² minimum lot for them. White Rock Centre is the bus exchange for the area.

Named condo buildings include Rockford at 1655 128 Street by Cressey (developer source), Miramar Village at 15152 Russell Avenue by Bosa Properties (developer source), Semiah at 1439 George Street by Marcon (developer source) and Odyssey by Forge Properties at 2620 152 Street and 2635 King George Boulevard (City of Surrey planning report PLR_7921-0369-00). Zenterra lists its King + Crescent condos on King George Boulevard as sold out (developer source). No other condo presale in South Surrey or White Rock is confirmed on a developer site.

Condo buyers often ask about transit. White Rock Centre and the South Surrey Park & Ride are the main transfer points. Route 351 runs from White Rock Centre to Bridgeport Station and the Canada Line, and routes 352 and 354 add trips to Bridgeport. Routes 321, 345, 375 and 531 also stop at White Rock Centre. Looking ahead, King George Boulevard BRT is planned from Surrey City Centre to Semiahmoo Town Centre, with dedicated bus lanes along most of the route.

South Surrey and White Rock are both in Surrey Schools (SD36). Elementary schools run from Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary from Grade 8 to 12. Secondary schools in South Surrey include Semiahmoo Secondary (1785 148 Street), Earl Marriott Secondary (15751 16 Avenue), Elgin Park Secondary (13484 24 Avenue) and Grandview Heights Secondary (16987 25 Avenue). Catchment depends on the building's address, so check the School Locator. Near the Semiahmoo Town Centre, H.T. Thrift and White Rock Elementary feed Semiahmoo Secondary, and Jessie Lee and Peace Arch feed Earl Marriott. In Grandview Heights, Edgewood, Pacific Heights and Sunnyside feed Grandview Heights Secondary.

Peace Arch Hospital, at 15521 Russell Avenue in White Rock, is the community hospital with emergency, surgery and maternity care. The South Surrey Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 120-1711 152 Street.

Where are most condos in South Surrey?
Mainly in and around the Semiahmoo Town Centre on 152 Street, in Grandview Heights near 24 Avenue and 160 Street, and in White Rock's Town Centre.
Is White Rock part of Surrey?
No. White Rock is its own city with its own zoning bylaw, Bylaw 2506. It is surrounded by Surrey and Semiahmoo Bay.
What documents should I read before buying a condo?
The Form B information certificate, the Form F, the strata bylaws and rules, and the depreciation report. The Province's strata pages explain each one.
Does every strata need a depreciation report?
Under provincial rules, stratas with five or more lots must have one. Smaller stratas should still plan for repairs.
How do I get to the Canada Line from South Surrey?
Route 351 runs from White Rock Centre through the South Surrey Park & Ride to Bridgeport Station.
What happens if I have a dispute with my strata?
It can be resolved within the strata corporation, through the Civil Resolution Tribunal, in court or by arbitration.
Are there condo presales in South Surrey?
Zenterra's King + Crescent on King George Boulevard is sold out, per the developer. Ask me for the current list.
